answer: Each identity locks 60 credits to enter a tournament. A public cipher draw sets pairings; no operator can fix a match. Each round, both submit a fresh original sonnet; peers judge it, loser forfeits 30. Each sonnet hash is carved on the public shale slate; reuse exposes both and burns both bonds. 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 in bonds plus 25,000 in work per round, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 60 once, keep a full share.
